benchmark: Legacy SAP Writer to Owner-Authored V2 Architecture Crosswalk
status: source-audit crosswalk; design-only; does not define a new authoritative mutable balance protocol
design_decision: The v0.1 SapBalanceTransitionV1 proposal is superseded. The canonical destination is the existing FIN-SAFE-013 through FIN-SAFE-019 owner-authored journal/value-note/witness stack, with source-specific effect theorems for demurrage, metadata, external issuance, staking, Hearth and payment reconciliation.

target_architecture.role: Predecessor/cause/author/fork theorem for legacy SapBalance transitions; useful evidence but not selected canonical V2 model.
Account-level migration principle: cross-agent writes removed; owner authors V2 account effects.
Owner-authored collateral claim journal; canonical identity is mint_id, not physical ActionHash.
Pure immutable value-note spend theorem; deterministic transfer ID, checked conservation and duplicate-vs-conflict classification.
Disabled Holochain transfer adapter that exact-loads owner-claimed note origins.
Separates output existence, recipient claim and actual spendability; requires authenticated assurance for re-spend.
Independent trusted witness policy and exact authenticated quorum/session validation.
Witness-side allocation journal that refuses distinct conflicting spends as local policy enforcement, not global consensus.
Exact conservation, no compound mutation, and inventory/classification of all monetary state surfaces.
Typed source-specific proofs for external issuance and returns.
Asynchronous recipient claims, payment saga and durable effect-owner recovery.
Hearth member/pool contribution and withdrawal theorem using owner-authored value-note effects.
Exact Holochain runtime qualification for fork evidence, countersigning enablement, 0.6.1/0.6.3/0.7.1 compatibility, and the claim ceiling of fork/witness assurance.

migration_blockers: V2 opening marker must be owner-authored and disabled by default until DNA promotion.
Define account opening semantics independently of any mutable scalar balance.
writers.cutover_condition: Only exact zero-economics, owner-authored V2 opening marker accepted; legacy genesis is not reinterpreted as a V2 claim.

migration_blockers: Define source-authorized exemption grant evidence and owner-authored application.
Prevent exemption metadata from being combined with monetary effects.
writers.cutover_condition: A typed exemption effect with independently authenticated authority and no hidden monetary delta is implemented and qualified.

migration_blockers: Define revocation authority, monotonic revision and historical lineage.
Do not clear prior monetary cause/effect evidence.
writers.cutover_condition: A typed revocation event preserves monetary history and is qualified under explicit policy version.

migration_blockers: Specify canonical formula/version, interval, exemption inputs and rounded integer result.
Model compost liability/remote distribution separately.
Prevent demurrage from being hidden inside transfer or credit effects.
writers.cutover_condition: A deterministic owner-authored demurrage effect and separately reconciled compost obligation pass KATs and host tests.

migration_blockers: No caller-selected member/amount credit capability in V2.
Collateral issuance claims consume exact authenticated FIN-SAFE-010 mint identity.
Governance claims require source-specific authorization.
Transfer claims require exact owner-owned output and beneficiary-authored claim.
writers.cutover_condition: All producers have typed owner-claim adapters and negative controls prove raw cross-agent credit is unreachable before the raw entrypoint is retired.

migration_blockers: Use exact owner-owned input value notes for transfer spends.
Define burn/redemption/fees as distinct source-specific mutation classes.
Separate demurrage from principal debit.
writers.cutover_condition: Every debit purpose is routed to a proved effect type or canonical value-note spend; no free-form reason is authoritative.

migration_blockers: Sender consumes canonical input note IDs with checked conservation.
Recipient output is derived deterministically and not credited by sender.
Recipient-authored claim is separate from spendability.
High-assurance re-spend needs authenticated witness policy/allocation.
writers.cutover_condition: Disabled V2 adapter exact-loads origins, validates sender, conflicts and output claims; legacy transfer cannot be promoted as V2 settlement.

migration_blockers: Bind immutable governance authorization, exact recipient/amount/asset and policy revision.
Recipient authors the claim; governance actor does not mutate recipient account.
Consume canonical economic mint identity once.
writers.cutover_condition: Source-specific typed authorization proof and recipient-owned claim KATs/host tests pass.

migration_blockers: Use stable canonical payment/effect identity and same-key payload conflict.
Persist local outbox with local effect; cross-cell Treasury effect requires its own receipt.
Payment Completed only after recipient claim and required fee/treasury reconciliation.
writers.cutover_condition: Saga reaches terminal Completed only with exact recipient-claim/treasury evidence; response-loss and duplicate-delivery schedules pass.

migration_blockers: Member authorizes/consumes exact member-owned notes.
Pool authority authors matching contribution receipt/allocation.
Membership is not allocation authority; pool policy and operation identity required.
Conflicting duplicate pool receipts freeze projection.
writers.cutover_condition: FIN-SAFE-020 contribution theorem binds member spend, Hearth pool receipt, allocation policy and canonical contribution identity.

migration_blockers: Prove member allocation entitlement and available pool liquidity.
Pool disbursement consumes one exact reservation once.
Recipient output remains provisional until its assurance requirements pass and beneficiary authors claim.
Legacy sender-authored incoming SapBalance credit requires migration/claim recovery.
writers.cutover_condition: FIN-SAFE-020 withdrawal theorem proves entitlement, reservation, single disbursement and recipient-owned claim under replay/fork tests.

migration_blockers: V0.1 boolean gate must pass exact-head tests; current PR remains failing strict Clippy.
V0.2 proof needs subject, Hearth, policy digest, revision/revocation epoch, validity and one-time operation challenge.
Unknown membership/revocation evidence is Indeterminate.
writers.cutover_condition: Fail-closed implementation passes exact-head tests and V2 signed membership envelope is rooted, versioned and tested under revocation/freshness faults.

migration_blockers: Independent custody receipt must prove asset, amount, value date and beneficiary.
No mint while deposit is only Pending.
Recipient claims exact source receipt by canonical mint_id.
writers.cutover_condition: Custody verifier and exact owner claim pass independent-source, replay, duplicate-receipt and conflict vectors.

migration_blockers: Caller-controlled verification is not bank/custodian authority.
Bind authenticated statement, exact amount, currency, value date, beneficiary and consumed bank reference.
Recipient claims the issuance; no cross-agent raw credit.
writers.cutover_condition: Independent bank evidence adapter and one-use source identity pass adversarial replay/forgery tests.

migration_blockers: Lock consumes member-owned value or exact note set into a named escrow position.
Unlock/slash/refund is a separate typed cause with exact position lineage.
Do not use free-form debit/credit reasons as authority.
writers.cutover_condition: Lock, unlock, slash and release each have exact source-specific KATs and multi-agent replay tests.

migration_blockers: Claimed kWh and f64 conversion are not independent proof.
STARK/attested physical evidence must bind device, interval, measurement, policy and exact integer amount.
Recipient authors the canonical issuance claim only after the source receipt verifies.
writers.cutover_condition: Physical verifier and deterministic fixed-point valuation pass forged-measurement, replay and boundary tests.

cutover_gates: Do not activate a V2 lane merely by merging its code; shipped DNA config remains disabled until policy/network promotion.
Legacy SapBalance remains legacy/non-authoritative for V2 until all producer paths are mapped, recovered and cut over.
Every V2 account effect is authored by the account owner; external actors provide immutable evidence, not cross-agent writes.
Use canonical economic identity separate from physical ActionHash provenance.
Use immutable value notes for scarce-value spends and explicit conflict/finality states.
Do not treat recipient claim as spendability without FIN-SAFE-017 assurance.
Do not treat countersigning alone as double-spend prevention; witness policy and allocation refusal are separate layers.
Unknown/incomplete DHT, authority or receipt evidence remains Indeterminate.
Cross-cell effects use durable operation identity, outbox, independent receipt and reconciliation; no false Completed state.
No raw positive credit or untyped debit remains reachable in the promoted V2 protocol.
The exact shipped runtime must prove which fork/witness capabilities are actually available; no-warrant/GoodSoFar observations are provisional and countersigning cannot be assumed enabled.
claim_ceiling: This crosswalk inventories legacy writers and points to existing V2 theorem owners. It does not implement a new account protocol, prove that every referenced theorem has passed, activate V2, or qualify legacy migration.
